# Lembar API Full Specification & Integration Guide

## 1. Authentication
All API requests use API key passed in the URL path:
`https://lembar.atnan.my.id/api/v1/{apiKey}/{sheetName}`

## 2. API Endpoints

### A. Read Rows (GET)
Returns all rows mapped by header names.
```bash
curl -X GET "https://lembar.atnan.my.id/api/v1/YOUR_API_KEY/Peserta"
```
Response:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "totalRows": 2,
  "headers": ["nama", "email", "status"],
  "data": [
    { "_rowNumber": 2, "nama": "Budi Santoso", "email": "budi@example.com", "status": "hadir" },
    { "_rowNumber": 3, "nama": "Siti Rahma", "email": "siti@example.com", "status": "hadir" }
  ]
}
```

### B. Append Row (POST)
Appends a single JSON row object to the end of the sheet.
```bash
curl -X POST "https://lembar.atnan.my.id/api/v1/YOUR_API_KEY/Peserta" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"nama": "Ahmad Fauzi", "email": "ahmad@example.com", "status": "hadir"}'
```

### C. Update Row (PUT)
Updates a specific row by its row number (rowId >= 2).
```bash
curl -X PUT "https://lembar.atnan.my.id/api/v1/YOUR_API_KEY/Peserta/2" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"status": "lulus"}'
```

### D. Delete Row (DELETE)
Deletes a row from the sheet.
```bash
curl -X DELETE "https://lembar.atnan.my.id/api/v1/YOUR_API_KEY/Peserta/2"
```

### E. Auto-Create Tab & Headers (POST)
Creates a new sheet tab and populates header row in row 1.
```bash
curl -X POST "https://lembar.atnan.my.id/api/v1/YOUR_API_KEY/TabBaru/create" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"headers": ["nama", "email", "status", "nilai"]}'
```

## 3. Code Examples

### JavaScript (fetch)
```javascript
const res = await fetch("https://lembar.atnan.my.id/api/v1/YOUR_API_KEY/Sheet1", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({ nama: "Budi", status: "hadir" }),
});
const data = await res.json();
```

### PHP (Laravel Http)
```php
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;

$response = Http::post("https://lembar.atnan.my.id/api/v1/YOUR_API_KEY/Sheet1", [
    "nama" => "Budi",
    "status" => "hadir",
]);
$data = $response->json();
```

### Python (requests)
```python
import requests

payload = {"nama": "Budi", "status": "hadir"}
response = requests.post("https://lembar.atnan.my.id/api/v1/YOUR_API_KEY/Sheet1", json=payload)
data = response.json()
```
